description: Activate when: user says 'decompose this', 'structure this thinking', 'MECE', 'issue tree', 'Minto Pyramid', 'how do we cover all the cases without double-counting', a problem feels too big to think about cleanly, a list of options is messy or overlapping, an analysis keeps going in circles, or a presentation needs to survive hard scrutiny. Do NOT activate when: the problem is trivially small (lunch decisions), or the user is in purely creative/generative mode where premature structure would constrain exploration. More: deciqai.com/c/mece

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent gather relevant evidence before concluding?
Did the final report trace conclusions back to observable evidence?
